caption: The drawing depicts a carved bird, positioned in profile and facing to the viewer's left, mounted on a simple, rounded pedestal base. The bird’s head and underside are yellow, with a bright red beak and a red rounded spot near its eye. The upper side of the body and the wings are green, with shading giving the impression of feather detail. The tail is a blend of brown, white, and yellowish hues. The bird is perched, with one visible red claw gripping what appears to be a round, red fruit or berry attached to the perch. The base is colored in shades of light gray, providing a neutral contrast to the bird’s brighter colors. The background is a plain, light beige color, and below the bird, the name “J. H. McCollum” is written in plain, small text.
title: Chalkware Bird
